sources.title: Reconstruction of interactions in the ProtoDUNE-SP detector with Pandora
sources.snippet: The Pandora Software Development Kit and algorithm libraries provide pattern-recognition logic essential to the reconstruction of particle interactions in liquid argon time projection chamber detectors.
